title.narrative: Yunnan Sayu River Basin Rural Water Pollution Management and Eco-Compensation Demonstration Project

description.narrative: The project will improve the condition of water resources and the environment by (i) strengthening wastewater management and pollution control with innovative technologies and arrangements; (ii) improving water resources management with innovative information technologies; (iii) establishing ecocompensation mechanisms; and (iv) strengthening education, capacity, and public awareness for water pollution management. The project is envisaged to (i) play a demonstrative role for rural areas with water pollution; (ii) promote regional public goods by reversing the negative impacts of pollution; and (iii) reduce the risk of future epidemics, which is strongly required after the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic.

description.narrative: Condition of water resources and environment in the Sayu River Basin improved

By 2027, monthly average total phosphorus in the Yudong Reservoir meets the Class II standard 10 times per year (2019 baseline: 8 times) Progress/Status: to be evaluated by project completion Data Source: b. Zhatong City Water Resources Bureau's data Actual value:

By 2027, monthly average total nitrogen in the Yudong Reservoir meets the Class III standard 10 times per year (2019 baseline: 9 times) Progress/Status: to be evaluated by project completion Data Source: a. Zhatong City Water Resources Bureau's data Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Eco-compensation mechanism for the Sayu River Basin established Indicator: By 2021, six eco-compensation agreements signed with Longshu, Shuimo, and Xinjie towns in Ludian County; and Leju and Sujia townships, and Sayu Town, in Zhaoyang District (2019 baseline: not applicable) (RFI B, C, D) Progress/Status: the eco-compensation framework is close to be finalized. Data Source: 3a. Surveys by consultants Actual value:

Output: Eco-compensation mechanism for the Sayu River Basin established Indicator: By 2023, at least 35% of the eco-compensation fund management committee members are women (2019 baseline: not applicable) (RFI K) Progress/Status: the percentage of women in the fund management committee is 43.75% (32 female) Data Source: 3c. Reports of the eco-compensation fund management committee and/or the Yudong Reservoir Water Resources Protection Committee Office Actual value:

Output: Eco-compensation mechanism for the Sayu River Basin established Indicator: By 2026, beneficiaries' cumulative payment into the eco-compensation fund exceeds CNY28.0 million (2019 baseline: not applicable) (RFI B, C, D) Progress/Status: In progress. Currently, the interim management measure for the specific fund has been issued, and CNY13.981 million of eco- compensation fund has been disbursed. Data Source: 3b. Reports of the eco-compensation fund management committee and/or the Yudong Reservoir Water Resources Protection Committee Office Actual value:

Output: Education, capacity, and public awareness for water pollution management strengthened Indicator: By 2026, at least 200 people (of whom at least 40% are women) report enhanced knowledge and skills on water pollution management (2019 baseline: not applicable) (RFI B, C, D) Progress/Status: 293 persons (of whom 47.44%, 139 persons are women) enhanced the knowledge of water pollution The target has been reached Data Source: 4b. Surveys by consultants and/or project progress reports Actual value:

Output: Education, capacity, and public awareness for water pollution management strengthened Indicator: By 2026, at least 12,550 students (of whom at least 40% are women) educated in water pollution management (2019 baseline: not applicable) Progress/Status: In progress. According to the external social monitoring report, a total of 25,376 students (of whom 48% are female) have received education on water resources protection and water pollution control. Data Source: 4a. Surveys by consultants and/or project progress reports Actual value:

Output: Education, capacity, and public awareness for water pollution management strengthened Indicator: By 2026, at least 32,750 people (of whom at least 40% are women) report enhanced awareness on water pollution management (2019 baseline: not applicable) (RFI B, C, D) Progress/Status: 26,229 persons (of whom 49%, 12,863 persons are women) enhanced awareness on water pollution. Data Source: 4c. Surveys by consultants and/or project progress reports Actual value:

Output: Education, capacity, and public awareness for water pollution management strengthened Indicator: By 2026, at least five other projects that referenced this project in their project documents (2019 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: In progress. Under ADB's guidance, Zhaotong City is considering to summarize the project experiences and compile them into a publication for promotion. The publication is expected to be completed in 2028, and this indicator will be achieved in 2028. Data Source: 4e. Surveys by consultants and/or project progress reports Actual value:

Output: Education, capacity, and public awareness for water pollution management strengthened Indicator: By 2026, garbage classification conducted in 20% of households in the Sayu River Basin and upper Yudong Reservoir (2019 baseline: 0%) (RFI B, C, D) Progress/Status: In progress. Currently, the solid waste management projects are implementing in Zhaoyang District and Ludian County. Publicity, education, and training on waste classification at the township level are also being carried out in an orderly manner, though achieving full waste classification will be a gradual process. It is planned that the 20% target will be achieved by the end of the project in 2028. Data Source: 4d. Surveys by village committees Actual value:

Output: Wastewater management and pollution control in the Sayu River Basin strengthened Indicator: 16,000 female farmers receive training and participate in the promotion of low-emissions agriculture (2019 baseline: not applicable) Progress/Status: In progress. According to the External Social Monitoring report, a total of 11,953 women farmers have been trained and participated in low-emission agricultural extension activities. Data Source: 1j. Project progress reports and/or external resettlement and social development monitoring and evaluation reports Actual value:

Output: Wastewater management and pollution control in the Sayu River Basin strengthened Indicator: By 2023, 138,584 m3/year of animal feces collected in tanks installed at 17,323 households (including 66,867 people, of whom 47.0% are women) in the Sayu River Basin (2019 baseline: not applicable, 0 households, 0 persons, 0% woman) (RFI B, C, D, G) Progress/Status: In progress. In 2025, 58,000 m3/year of animal feces collected in tanks installed at 12,054 households (including 47,487 people, of whom 47% are women) Data Source: 1c. Surveys conducted by village committees Actual value:

Output: Wastewater management and pollution control in the Sayu River Basin strengthened Indicator: By 2025, six artificial wetlands operational to reduce nonpoint source pollution (2019 baseline: Not applicable) (RFI A, B, C, D, G, H, I, J) Progress/Status: The six aritificial wetlands in the original indicator are Xinhe, Longxiang, Longshu, Zhongheba, Dahaizi, and Xiaohebian Wetlands. Due to land constraints, Longxiang, Longshu, Zhongheba, and Xiaohebian Wetlands have been canceled. Only Xinhe Wetland and Dahaizi Wetland in the original indicator are retained; Shanqiao Wetland (associated with Dahaizi Wetland) and Jule River Wetland (added during the mid-term adjustment) are newly included. The original target cannot be achieved by 2026 and needs to be adjusted to four aritificial wetlands. Data Source: 1g. Environmental monitoring reports Actual value:

Output: Wastewater management and pollution control in the Sayu River Basin strengthened Indicator: By 2026, 15,359 households (including 59,286 people, of whom 47.0% are women) in the Sayu River Basin connected with wastewater facilities (2019 baseline: 0 households, 0% women) (RFI A, B, C, D, F, G, H, I) Progress/Status: By now, 21,128 households (including 79,144 people, of whom 46% are women) in the Sayu River Basin connected with wastewater pipeline networks funded by ADB loan and counterpart funds. Data Source: 1b. Surveys conducted by village committees Actual value:

Output: Wastewater management and pollution control in the Sayu River Basin strengthened Indicator: By 2026, 2,500 people (of whom 40% are women) in three pilot eco-villages participate in activities for and/or education on environmental protection (2019 baseline: not applicable) (RFI F) Progress/Status: In progress. According to the External Social Monitoring report for the first half of 2025, 1,402 people (48.07% are women) in the three pilot eco-villages were involved in environmental education and/or activities. Data Source: 1f. Project progress reports and/or external resettlement and social development monitoring and evaluation reports Actual value:

Output: Wastewater management and pollution control in the Sayu River Basin strengthened Indicator: By 2026, 60,000 women with increased time savings for wastewater, animal feces, and solid waste management (2019 baseline: not applicable) (RFI E) Progress/Status: In 2025, there are 54,000 women in the runoff zone. Data Source: 1e. Surveys conducted by village committees Actual value:

Output: Wastewater management and pollution control in the Sayu River Basin strengthened Indicator: By 2024, 84 tons/day of solid waste from 30,890 households (including 118,798 people, of whom 47.0% are women) in the Sayu River Basin treated (2019 baseline: 25 tons/day, 0 households, 0 persons, 0% woman)d (RFI A, B, C, D, F, G, H, I) Progress/Status: In progress. In 2025, the population of the runoff area is 114,798, and the amount of solid waste is 61 tons. Data Source: 1d. Operation reports of the two pyrolysis plants Actual value:

Output: Wastewater management and pollution control in the Sayu River Basin strengthened Indicator: By 2023, wastewater treatment capacity in the Sayu River Basin increased to 2,738 m3/day (2019 baseline: 2,535 m3/day) (RFI A, B, C, D, F, G, H, I) Progress/Status: In progress. By November 2025, wastewater treatment capacity in the Sayu River Basin increased to 2755 m3/day. Data Source: 1a.-1d. Reports and/or records of Zhaotong City, Zhaoyang District, and Ludian County governments; and ADB mission reports, quarterly project progress reports, and project completion report1a. Operation reports of the WWT plant and 44 WWT facilities Actual value:

Output: Wastewater management and pollution control in the Sayu River Basin strengthened Indicator: By 2026, chemical fertilizer nitrogen loss reduced to 3.920 kg/ha and phosphor loss reduced to 0.077 kg/ha, in the low-emission agriculture pilot areas (2017 baseline: 5.670 kg/ha [nitrogen] and 0.110 kg/ha [phosphor])f (RFI A, B, C, D, H) Progress/Status: In progress. At present, the C12 in Ludian and C17 in Zhaoyang have completed, but integrated water and fertilizer facilities hasn't put into operation, no data was collected. The monitoring plan is under preparation Data Source: 1i. Reports of soil and fertilizer stations of Zhaotong City, Zhaoyang District, and Ludian County Actual value:

Output: Wastewater management and pollution control in the Sayu River Basin strengthened Indicator: By 2026, the quantifiable soil and water conservation model tentatively established using available monitoring data (2019 baseline: Not applicable)e (RFI A, B, C, D, G, H, I, J) Progress/Status: the model is established by Dec 2024. Data Source: 1h. Surveys by consultants Baseline year: 2019 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2019 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y

Output: Water resources management in the Sayu River improved Indicator: By 2024, data on water quality in rivers in the Sayu River Basin automatically sent to mobile devices of the “river chiefs” in real time (2019 baseline: not applicable)g (RFI A, B, C, D, H) Progress/Status: contract G4 was awarded in Nov 2025. Data Source: 2a. Surveys by consultants Baseline year: 2019 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2019 Baseline value: N Target year: 2024 Target value: Y
